actions.text: A founder who lists tools by failure mode, not hype cycle. This is the actual shortlist.
Do not give away equity blind: a valuation is not guesswork, it decides whether you stay the owner.
Eating glass and staring into the abyss: somehow still a better pitch than most hustle-posts.
ChatGPT as a brainstorming intern is fair. Just remember it confidently hallucinates suppliers too.
Google giving away the most powerful free AI tool feels like a glitch. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Free-tier video gens doing storyboards that cost studios thousands two years ago. Wild timeline.
Single image in, talking character out, free tier. The uncanny valley just got a commute.
Founder marketing is just reality TV for startups: document the struggle, sell the sequel.
